from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class FeeAllocation(BaseModel):
    """Details of a specific court fee assignment in the judgment."""
    party_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the party responsible for the fee")
    fee_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g. 'Second Instance Court Fee'")
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The amount to be paid")

class JudgmentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document to enable matching."""
    case_number: Optional[str] = Field(description="Official case identifier number, e.g. (2023) 粤 0112 民初 3557 号")
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Full name of the court issuing the judgment")
    parties: List[str] = Field(description="List of all named individuals and organizations in the case")
    case_nature: Optional[str] = Field(description="Nature of the proceeding, e.g., Civil Second Instance, Criminal Appeal, Execution Objection")
    core_ruling: Optional[str] = Field(description="The primary judicial decision, e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判'")
    disputed_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="Specific monetary value in dispute or ordered payment")
    court_fee_total: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total court fee amount mentioned")
    fee_distributions: List[FeeAllocation] = Field(description="Details of fee payment responsibility split among parties")
    verbatim_snippet: str = Field(description="A short text excerpt confirming the court and case details")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentExtraction]
